description: Send an email using a saved template with variable substitution. Variables like {{name}} are replaced.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

wake.description: Optional. Names of the agents who should get a host turn when this template-rendered mail lands. Pass `[]` to deliver silently. Omit to wake everyone CC'd.

name: template_send
